title: Diagnostic criteria for diffuse glioneuronal tumour with oligodendroglioma-like features and nuclear clusters (DGONC)
tablehtml:
Essential:

Methylation profile of DGONC

AND

Nuclear clusters of small to medium-sized cells exhibiting oligodendroglioma-like morphology

AND

Strong expression of both OLIG2 and synaptophysin

AND

Absence of widespread GFAP expression

Desirable:

Monosomy of chromosome 14

Caveat: DNA methylation profiling is so far the only method to clearly identify DGONC. If DNA methylation profiling is not available, morphological features may provide an approximation.
